title: find-files-by-schema match
description: One line of `find-files-by-schema --output=jsonl`: a repo file whose schema: URI resolves to a tcms-schemas type. Each stdout line is one JSON object of this shape.

path.description: File path relative to the scan root (--root), with '/' separators.

schema.description: Vendored schema file the file's schema: URI resolves to, relative to schemas/tcms-schemas/, for example tcms/test-run.schema.json.

type.description: Value of the document's top-level type: field, or null when the document has none.
